basic_info.description: Enjoy the quiet convenience of San Francisco's Lakeside neighborhood from this beautifully remodeled split level home. As you step inside, you'll be welcomed by an abundance of natural light streaming through the skylight and numerous windows. The open floor plan seamlessly connects the living areas, creating an inviting space for entertaining. The brand-new gourmet kitchen, equipped with premium appliances and elegant finishes, is a chef's dream.    The upper level boasts a stylish primary bedroom with an en-suite bathroom, a second bedroom, and a chic hallway bathroom. The lower level offers another en-suite bedroom with direct access to the refreshed backyard, perfect for relaxation and outdoor gatherings.    Conveniently located near SF State, Stonestown, and the Chinese American International School, this home provides easy access to I-280 and Muni's M Oceanview light rail line, ensuring a smooth commute and access to all that San Francisco has to offer.
